name: Financial Data Protection Policy
description:
Thematic policy for financial data: payment cards and their verification values, bank accounts, routing and sort codes, IBAN and SWIFT/BIC identifiers, cryptocurrency addresses, securities identifiers, and the country-specific account formats the catalog carries. Membership is the whole financial category.

Jurisdiction-free by design (D17) — the configuration's region lens narrows country-specific formats to the jurisdictions the user operates in. PCI-DSS-specific handling belongs in the pci overlay, not here; this theme answers "is this financial data?", not "which regime governs it?".

Scope: Financial and cardholder data — global, category-driven
